profile_text.body:
Tsinghua University is a university in Beijing, China, operating as a non-profit institution. Its website is tsinghua.edu.cn. The site text itself offers only the institution's name, so there is little on the page describing its activities in its own words.

The record also lists two aliases, THUNLP and Tsinghua AIR, which indicate lab or research groupings associated with the university. No products are tracked for it, no MCP servers are listed, and no lawsuits are recorded.
